localBiteReport: The fall transition is underway on Choctawhatchee Bay and the Destin inshore fishery as of the week of September 18–24, 2026. Redfish are the standout bite right now, with slot fish and oversized bulls spread from the pass throughout Santa Rosa Sound and into the main bay system. An abundance of bait has made catching easier and is directly fueling the action for redfish, flounder, and speckled trout around the Destin area — one local guide describes the inshore bite as among the best he has seen all year. Water temperature is 86°F. Early-morning trips are recommended to beat heat-related midday slowdowns, and tidal movement remains critical for consistent results on all inshore species.
